observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same white Xbox One S console with a black controller on top.
The console has a perforated front panel and a visible disc slot.
The controller has the standard Xbox design with colored face buttons (A, B, X, Y) and a central guide button.
The console appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and wear.
No games, cables, or accessories are visible in the photos.
The background is plain blue, suggesting a studio or controlled lighting setup.

claims.evidence: No proof of origin or usage history is visible in the photos. The seller's text alone cannot confirm UK origin.

claims.claim: Comes with 8 offline games on it
claims.evidence: No games are visible in the photos. The claim cannot be confirmed without additional evidence.

claims.claim: Comes with one original Xbox one s wireless controller
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a black controller with the Xbox design, consistent with an original Xbox One S controller.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game.

risks.risk: Games may be missing or not included as claimed
risks.proof: Photos of the 8 offline games or a video showing them being loaded and played.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional or damaged
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: Console may have been tampered with or have hidden damage (e.g., disc drive, ports)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the disc slot, ports, and internal components (if possible) or a video showing the console in use.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Photos or video of the 8 offline games.
Video of the controller connecting and functioning.
Close-up photos of the disc slot, ports, and internal components.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
